completeDraftSets.camera: Fixed side three-quarter, head left and feet right, slight elevation shows both arms and both planted shoes.
completeDraftSets.equipment: Bodyweight on level floor; no foot restraint or weights.

muscles.note: Qualitative visible hierarchy. Catalogue hip flexors are deep and are not drawn through the body.

reviewFindings: Three distinct native poses selected as 1,2,3,3,2,1 in six separate files. Peak/return reuse is explicit; this is not six unique poses.

The first intended early-curl edit rose farther than requested and was selected as the peak. The next intermediate attempt rose higher still and is rejected. A retry from the flat master gives an intermediate between flat and peak, with uneven spacing; no smooth-motion claim.

Native review shows the intended bent-knee crunch and stable canonical identity/muscle hierarchy. Fixed-contact measurements prevent release: intermediate near heel shifts +1x/+2y, near toe +3x/0y, far toe +3x/+1y; peak far toe +2x/0y. The strict release tolerance is 1px.

Pelvis patch shifts at most 1px. Patch matching can also respond to shading and outline changes; these findings do not certify all anatomy or hand contact. No pixel compositing, warping, cropping or rescaling was used.
Side Plank remains unreleased with its existing 12px shoe displacement. Its failed repair method was not repeated.

All 24 browser checks passed, including the three Crunches checks for light, dark and reduced motion. The six displayed frames, cues, actual 6-to-1 timer, identical endpoint pixels, 44px controls and lack of overflow/page errors were checked. All three unique displayed poses were inspected in both themes; small intermediate-to-peak spacing remains visible. These player results do not clear the failed contact checks. No public assets or release approval.

frames.caption: SET AND BRACE 1/6
frames.cue: Plant feet; rest hands lightly behind head.

frames.caption: BEGIN CURL 2/6
frames.cue: Curl your shoulders up using your abs.

frames.caption: LIFT SHOULDERS 3/6
frames.cue: Lift shoulder blades; keep lower back down.

frames.caption: PAUSE BRIEFLY 4/6
frames.cue: Pause without pulling on your neck.

frames.caption: LOWER SLOWLY 5/6
frames.cue: Lower your shoulders slowly with control.

frames.caption: RETURN TO FLOOR 6/6
frames.cue: Rest shoulders; keep your feet planted.
